events.title: Baybars seizes the Mamluk throne after Qutuz is assassinated
events.description: Shortly after Qutuz and Baybars defeated the Mongols at Ain Jalut, Sultan Qutuz was assassinated, and Baybars seized the throne as the fourth Mamluk sultan of Egypt and Syria. He reigned until 1277.
events.html: Shortly after Qutuz and Baybars defeated the Mongols at Ain Jalut, Sultan Qutuz was assassinated, and Baybars seized the throne as the fourth Mamluk sultan of Egypt and Syria. He reigned until 1277.

events.title: Rudolf of Habsburg is crowned King of the Romans at Aachen
events.description: Rudolf of Habsburg, a Swabian count elected King of the Romans that year, was crowned in Aachen Cathedral, the first of his house to hold the title. His election ended the Great Interregnum after the fall of the Hohenstaufen.

events.title: The Treaty of Brétigny is ratified at Calais
events.description: Edward III and John II of France ratified at Calais the peace agreed at Brétigny in May. England gained Aquitaine and Calais in full sovereignty and a huge ransom for the captured French king, pausing the Hundred Years' War.

events.title: The Peace of Westphalia ends the Thirty Years' War
events.description: Treaties signed at Münster and Osnabrück ended the Thirty Years' War, which had devastated central Europe. The settlement confirmed the autonomy of the German princes and recognised Dutch and Swiss independence.
events.html: Treaties signed at Münster and Osnabrück ended the Thirty Years' War, which had devastated central Europe. The settlement confirmed the autonomy of the German princes and recognised Dutch and Swiss independence.

events.title: The Brabant Revolution begins in the Austrian Netherlands
events.description: An émigré army from the Dutch Republic invaded the Austrian Netherlands, beginning the Brabant Revolution against Emperor Joseph II's centralising and church reforms. The rebels drove out the Austrian forces and in January 1790 proclaimed the United Belgian States.

events.title: Black Thursday: panic selling hits Wall Street
events.description: Nearly 13 million shares changed hands as panic swept the New York Stock Exchange. Bankers briefly steadied prices, but the crash that followed the next week opened the way to the Great Depression.
events.html: Nearly 13 million shares changed hands as panic swept the New York Stock Exchange. Bankers briefly steadied prices, but the crash that followed the next week opened the way to the Great Depression.

events.title: The United Nations comes into being
events.description: The United Nations Charter entered into force once a majority of signatories, including the five permanent Security Council members, had ratified it. The date is celebrated annually as United Nations Day.
events.html: The United Nations Charter entered into force once a majority of signatories, including the five permanent Security Council members, had ratified it. The date is celebrated annually as United Nations Day.

events.title: Concorde makes its last commercial flight
events.description: British Airways Concorde flight BA002 from New York landed at Heathrow, ending 27 years of supersonic passenger travel. The aircraft could cross the Atlantic in about three and a half hours.
